privacy.declineNote: Decline analytics cookies when prompted, or clear site data to be asked again.

calculations.p1: Every calculation runs in your browser. The amounts you type, the rate you select and the results are never transmitted to a server, because the arithmetic does not need a server to happen.
calculations.p2: One consequence worth understanding: when you use the share button, your figures are placed in the URL. That link is safe to share — it contains an amount and a rate, nothing about you — but it is still a link containing your numbers, so treat it the way you would treat any link you send someone.

localStorage.p1: None of it leaves your device. There is no account, nothing is synced, and clearing your browser data removes all of it. The calculator also has a
localStorage.p2: button that removes saved calculations immediately. If local storage is unavailable — private browsing, or storage blocked — everything still works, it simply forgets between visits.

analytics.p2: — cookieless, and records page views rather than individuals. No consent prompt is shown because no cookie is set.
analytics.p3: — sets cookies, so it loads only after you accept the prompt. It starts in a denied state and stays there unless you choose otherwise.

contact.p1: The form is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile, which checks that a submission comes from a person rather than a script. Turnstile is provided by Cloudflare and processes a token along with your IP address for that check.
contact.p2: No submission provider is configured, so there is no form to submit and no message data is collected or stored.

infrastructure.p1: This site does not operate a database. There is nowhere for personal data to accumulate because no such store exists.

prose.localStorageIntro: With your action, this site stores a few things in your own browser’s local storage:
prose.noAnalytics: No analytics provider is configured, so this site loads no tracking script and sets no analytics cookie. Our host does not add one either: Cloudflare’s Web Analytics was injecting a script into pages as they were served, and it has been turned off for this site. Verified after the change — no request to any analytics host is made when a page loads.
prose.contactForm: If you send a message through the contact form, the name, email address, subject and message you enter are transmitted to this site’s server and forwarded to the configured destination so it can be read and replied to. They are used for nothing else, and message content is not written to server logs.
prose.infrastructure: This site runs on Cloudflare Workers. As with any web host, Cloudflare processes the requests needed to serve pages, which involves your IP address and browser user agent, and it applies its own network-level security handling. That processing is governed by Cloudflare’s own privacy terms rather than by this site.
prose.calculatorValues: Calculator values are never sent to analytics. Which pages are visited is useful; how much Robux you hold is not our business.
prose.externalLinks: Pages here link to official Roblox documentation, to the European Central Bank, and to other sources listed in the {sourceRegistry}. Following one of those links takes you to a site with its own privacy practices, which this policy does not cover.
prose.contactThrough: Contact us about anything in this policy through the {contactPage}.

terms.intro: The terms covering use of this site. Short, because there is not much to it — you use a calculator, and it gives you an estimate.

use.p1: You are welcome to use {host} freely to estimate DevEx payouts, for yourself or as part of your work as a creator. No account is needed and nothing is charged.
use.p3: What is asked in return: do not attempt to disrupt the site or the infrastructure it runs on, do not scrape it in a way that degrades it for others, and if you republish figures from it, cite the source and include the verification date. A rate quoted without its date becomes wrong without warning, and that misleads whoever reads it next.

estimates.p1: Every figure on this site is an estimate produced by applying publicly documented rates to numbers you entered. None of it is financial advice, tax advice, legal advice, or a professional opinion of any kind.
estimates.p2: Considerable care goes into accuracy — every rate is sourced, dated and covered by tests — but rates change, documentation moves, and errors are possible. Check anything you are relying on against the official Roblox documentation linked from the
estimates.p3: before making a decision that matters.

affiliation.p1: This site is independent. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or operated by Roblox Corporation. Roblox, Robux and Developer Exchange are trademarks of Roblox Corporation, referenced here descriptively to identify what these calculations concern.
affiliation.p2: This site cannot influence, expedite, predict or guarantee the outcome of a DevEx request, and has no access to any Roblox account or balance.

liability.p1: This site is provided as it is, without warranty of any kind. To the fullest extent the law allows, no liability is accepted for loss or damage arising from use of it — including decisions made on the basis of an estimate shown here, a figure that has since changed, or the site being unavailable.
liability.p2: Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

prose.exactButEstimate: The calculator multiplies the Robux figure you enter by a rate taken from Roblox’s published documentation. That arithmetic is exact and covered by tests. What it produces is still an estimate, because the inputs are assumptions: that the Robux you entered are eligible Earned Robux, and that the rate you selected is the one Roblox will apply to them.

accessibility.intro: What this site targets, what has actually been tested, and what is still imperfect.

features.errorsTied: Errors are tied to their fields
features.targetsDetail: Buttons, preset chips, links in navigation and form controls all meet that minimum.
features.zoomDetail: The viewport sets no maximum scale, so pinch-zoom works everywhere.
features.keyboardDetail: Every control is a real button, link, input or select. There are no clickable divs, so keyboard behaviour comes from the browser rather than from scripts imitating it.
features.focusDetail: A three-pixel amber outline with a two-pixel offset, chosen because it measures about 5:1 against every surface on the site — comfortably above the 3:1 the standard requires.
features.announcedDetail: Calculation results, copy confirmations and error messages are announced through a polite live region, summarised rather than read digit by digit as you type.
features.errorsTiedDetail: Validation messages are linked with aria-describedby and the field is marked invalid, so a screen reader reports the problem with the field rather than as loose text nearby.
features.notColourAloneDetail: The threshold meter, rate comparisons and stale-rate warnings each carry a text label saying what the colour says.
features.mobileMenuDetail: Escape closes it and returns focus to the button that opened it, focus is trapped while it is open, and background scrolling is locked without the page shifting.
features.tablesScrollDetail: Each table sits in a focusable, labelled scroll container, so a keyboard user can reach and scroll it without a mouse.
features.noJsDetail: Rates, formulas, worked examples, tables, navigation and every explanation are server rendered. Only live recalculation needs scripts.

tested.p1: Automated checks catch a minority of real accessibility problems, so the keyboard walkthrough and the manual layout checks matter more than the axe results do.

limitations.p1: No testing has been done with a live screen reader by someone who uses one daily. Semantics have been built and inspected carefully, but that is not the same thing, and reports from actual users are genuinely wanted.
limitations.p2: Very long numbers in a result wrap rather than shrink. At 320 pixels with 200% zoom a ten-figure payout can occupy three lines. Wrapping was chosen over truncating, since a truncated money figure is worse than a tall one.
limitations.p3: The rate comparison and breakdown tables scroll horizontally on narrow screens. The scroll container is keyboard reachable and labelled, but a table is still harder to read that way than a wider viewport allows.

feedback.p1: If something here blocks you, telling us is the fastest way to get it fixed. Include the page, what you were trying to do, and the browser and assistive technology you were using if that is relevant. Accessibility reports are treated with the same priority as a wrong rate — both make the site fail at its job.

tested.keyboard: Keyboard-only walkthrough of the calculator, navigation and every form
tested.narrowLayout: Layout at 320px wide with no horizontal scrolling
tested.zoom: Layout at 200% text zoom with no loss of content or function
